source_context.reason: Public article describes concepts and reported outcomes but not complete executable rules for S10/S9/S6. We freeze simple auditable interpretations before looking at our own results.

data.missing_bars: No interpolation; any trade needing a missing entry/exit bar is ineligible.
data.note: The public AlphaInsider source may have inspected overlapping history. This is an external-idea plausibility scan, not independent OOS validation.

economics.primary_control: fully reversed execution at identical timestamps

AI_S10_GAP_REGIME_V1.source_idea: small gaps tend to fill; large gaps tend to continue; focus on first hour
AI_S10_GAP_REGIME_V1.gap_definition: today 09:30 ET open versus previous regular-session final close
AI_S10_GAP_REGIME_V1.small_gap_exit: first 5-minute bar after entry whose range touches prior close; execute next 5-minute open; otherwise 10:30 ET open

AI_S9_VWAP_CONT_V1.source_idea: trend day continuation; VWAP acts as support in uptrend/resistance in downtrend
AI_S9_VWAP_CONT_V1.vwap: cumulative regular-session VWAP reconstructed as sum(minute_vwap*volume)/sum(volume)
AI_S9_VWAP_CONT_V1.long_state: close > cumulative VWAP AND close > close 30 minutes ago AND VWAP > VWAP 30 minutes ago
AI_S9_VWAP_CONT_V1.long_pullback: bar low <= cumulative VWAP AND bar close > cumulative VWAP
AI_S9_VWAP_CONT_V1.short_state: close < cumulative VWAP AND close < close 30 minutes ago AND VWAP < VWAP 30 minutes ago
AI_S9_VWAP_CONT_V1.short_pullback: bar high >= cumulative VWAP AND bar close < cumulative VWAP

AI_S6_INITIAL_BALANCE_V1.source_idea: initial-balance breakout; reported strongest on TSLA and some correlation on mega caps
AI_S6_INITIAL_BALANCE_V1.initial_balance: 09:30-09:59 ET high/low using first six 5-minute bars
AI_S6_INITIAL_BALANCE_V1.long_signal: first 5-minute close strictly above initial-balance high
AI_S6_INITIAL_BALANCE_V1.short_signal: first 5-minute close strictly below initial-balance low

plausibility_gate_per_family.10bps_stress: must be reported, not mandatory for plausibility

next_step_if_survives: Create a new frozen candidate ID, run non-overlap historical replication and then genuine post-freeze shadow. Do not promote directly from this scan.
